title: Chana Sundal
description: A Tamil temple-style chickpea stir fry tempered with mustard seeds, curry leaves, red chilli and fresh coconut.
steps: Pressure cook the soaked chickpeas with the salt and enough water for 4 to 5 whistles until soft; drain well.
Heat the coconut oil in a pan and crackle the mustard seeds.
Add the urad dal and fry until golden, followed by the dried red chilli, curry leaves and hing.
Add the drained chickpeas and toss on medium heat for 2 minutes.
Stir in the grated coconut, mix well and serve warm.
